title: Base ForwardOpen variant 1
purpose: Cover a distinct explicit messaging service family using a conservative SendRRData carrier and a non-trivial ForwardOpen-like CIP body with varied path fields.
expected_behavior: Parser accepts a complete encapsulated explicit request, traverses SendRRData and CPF item parsing, then reaches a ForwardOpen-like CIP service and path structure without basic framing inconsistencies.
constraints_preserved: Prefer EtherNet/IP encapsulation headers with little-endian payload length
Use a 24-byte encapsulation header when that form is selected
Diversify discovery, session and explicit-message paths
issue_safety_notes: Constructed from model-internal prior only. Framing and field relationships were kept conservative and internally consistent, but no external verification or issue knowledge was used.
